studio.dashboard.description: A snapshot of your player community.
studio.dashboard.registeredHelp: Player accounts with an initialized profile.
studio.dashboard.activeHelp: Distinct signed-in players who opened or had the app visible in this period.
studio.dashboard.activityNote: Activity is recorded only after the updated app and admin API are deployed. Earlier activity and visitors who are not signed in are not included. Counts may lag by up to 15 minutes.
studio.settings.chatHelp: These limits apply per account and per action across all connections. Changes apply to new requests. Fixed windows can allow a larger burst at the boundary; changing a window starts a new counter.
studio.settings.gatewayHelp: API Gateway's shared throttling is configured separately when deploying the chat service. These settings do not change it.
studio.errors.chatSettingsInvalid: Enter whole numbers within the allowed ranges for every limit.
studio.errors.chatSettingsUnavailable: The chat table is not configured for this environment.
studio.errors.chatSettingsConflict: Someone else changed these settings. Refresh the page and try again.
studio.access.denied: This account does not have access to this studio. Contact a studio administrator.
studio.access.pending: Your account is ready. A studio administrator needs to assign a role before you can access modules.
studio.access.moduleDenied: Your role does not have View access to this module. Choose an available module from the menu.
studio.users.description: Manage studio contributors, personal profiles, and assigned roles.
studio.users.createNote: Create a studio account with the same details used during registration, then assign a role.
studio.users.emptyDescription: Seed the existing studio users or add a new contributor.
studio.users.removeConfirm: Remove studio access for {name}? Their Cognito account will be retained.
studio.users.created: User created. They can sign in with the password you provided.
studio.users.emailImmutable: Email is the sign-in identity and cannot be changed here.
studio.roles.description: Choose View, Add, Edit, Delete, Upload, and Download access for each studio module.
studio.roles.name: Role name
studio.roles.emptyDescription: Run the studio access seed to create Root, then add roles for contributors.
studio.roles.rootNote: Root has every permission and cannot be edited or deleted.
studio.roles.futureNote: Upload and Download permissions are available for current media workflows and future bulk import or export tools.
studio.roles.viewNote: View is required before enabling other permissions for a module.
studio.auth.signInNote: Use your studio account to contribute to AmbatuApp.
studio.auth.registerNote: Tell us about yourself. After email verification, a studio administrator will assign your role.
studio.auth.newPasswordNote: Set a personal password to finish accepting your studio invitation.
studio.auth.verifyNote: Enter the verification code sent to {email}, then sign in to complete your profile.
studio.auth.codeSent: A new verification code has been sent.
studio.auth.verified: Email verified. Sign in to finish creating your studio profile.
studio.auth.invited: Your invitation uses a temporary password. Choose a new password to continue.
studio.auth.completeNote: Add your personal details to finish joining the studio.
studio.errors.viewRequired: Enable View before selecting other permissions for a module.
studio.errors.profile: Complete all required personal details within the field limits.
studio.errors.password: Use a password of 8 to 256 characters that meets the account password policy.
studio.errors.firestore: The studio data service is not configured.
studio.errors.rootProtected: Root cannot be edited or deleted.
studio.errors.roleName: Enter a role name of up to 80 characters and a description of up to 500 characters.
studio.errors.roleMissing: This role no longer exists. Choose another role.
studio.errors.roleInUse: Reassign this role's users before deleting it.
studio.errors.userMissing: This studio user no longer exists.
studio.errors.rootAssignment: Only Root users can assign or remove Root access.
studio.errors.selfChange: You cannot change your own role or remove your own studio access.
studio.errors.lastRoot: At least one active Root user must remain.
studio.errors.forbidden: Your account does not have permission for this action.
studio.errors.verifyEmail: Verify your email before completing registration.
studio.errors.request: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
studio.errors.authentication: Sign-in could not be completed. Check your details and try again.
studio.errors.accountExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or verify your email.
studio.errors.invalidPassword: The password does not meet the account password policy.
studio.errors.invalidCode: The verification code is invalid or expired. Request a new code.
studio.errors.registrationDisabled: Registration is currently unavailable. Contact a studio administrator.
studio.errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
studio.errors.registrationPending: This user must finish registration before a role can be assigned.
